issues.problem: Going from $96.8B to $97.7B is about 0.9% growth, not 9.9%. Tesla's reported 2024 revenue growth was about 1%.

data.summary: The analysis is not accurate: one figure is wrong. Your text says all figures are pre-verified and should be marked VERIFIED, but I checked them anyway. Revenue going from $96.8B to $97.7B is growth of about 0.9%, not 9.9%. The other figures match Tesla's reported FY2024 results: revenue of about $97.7B, net income of about $7.1B, operating income of about $7.1B, total assets of about $122.1B, and cash and cash equivalents of about $16.1B.
